questions.explain: SqlClient keeps one pool per unique connection-string text; a fresh physical connection costs 20–100 ms (TCP+TLS+login) while a pool checkout costs microseconds.
options: One pool per database user
One pool per unique connection string; checkouts cost microseconds vs 20–100 ms for a fresh connection
One pool per SQL Server instance, shared by all apps
Pools are created per query, not per connection string
